d:
All episodes previously translated using single episode releases are remastered with tankōbon source, along with some typesetting and typo/grammar fixes. Also includes a new extra short Seven O’clock.

The tankōbon features a higher and consistent resolution, many redraws in details, slightly different censorship (some panes lighter, a few panes heavier). Overall, much better image quality.

Story-wise, this is the third volume of Yamamoto Naoki Latest Series, though it’s somewhat a standalone story of its own. The two previous volumes are much shorter, and have not get tankōbon release at the moment, which is a bit weird of a publication choice.
